bara imambara.title: Bara Imambara
bara imambara.summary: The Bara Imambara, also known as the Asafi Imambara, is a significant imambara and mosque complex located in Lucknow, in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India. Built by Asaf-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh, in 1784, it is the world's second largest imambara, after the Nizamat Imambara..

chota imambara.title: Chota Imambara
chota imambara.summary: Imambara Hussainabad Mubarak, popularly known as Chhota Imambara, is a monument located in the city of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It took 54 years to build.

hazratganj.title: Hazratganj
hazratganj.summary: Hazratganj is the central business district of Lucknow, the capital and largest city of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. In addition to bazaars, it also contains shopping complexes, restaurants, hotels, theatres, cafés and many offices.

rumi darwaza.title: Rumi Darwaza
rumi darwaza.summary: The Rumi Darwaza, in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, is a gateway which was built by Nawab Asaf-Ud-Daula in 1784. It is an example of Awadhi architecture.

lucknow zoo.title: Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Prani Udyan
lucknow zoo.summary: Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Prani Udyan, earlier known as Prince of Wales Zoological Gardens or popularly known as Lucknow Zoological Garden, and Banaarsi Baag, is a 71.6-acre (29.0 ha) zoo located in the heart of the capital city of Uttar Pradesh named after Wajid Ali Shah - the last Nawab of Awadh. According to the Central Zoo Authority of India, it is a large zoo.

la martiniere college.title: La Martinière College
la martiniere college.summary: La Martinière College is a consortium of bi-national elite private schools, majority of them located in India. They are officially non-denominational private schools with units of two branches each in Indian cities of Kolkata and Lucknow; and in France, the consortium is represented by a number of three branches in Lyon..

begum hazrat mahal park.title: Begum Hazrat Mahal
begum hazrat mahal park.summary: Begum Hazrat Mahal, also known as the Begum of Awadh, was the second wife of Nawab of Awadh Wajid Ali Shah, and the regent of Awadh in 1857–1858. She is known for the leading role she had in the rebellion against the British East India Company during the Indian Rebellion of 1857..

ambedkar memorial.title: Ambedkar Memorial Park
ambedkar memorial.summary: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Samajik Parivartan Sthal, is a public memorial in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

lucknow museum.title: State Museum, Lucknow
lucknow museum.summary: State Museum, Lucknow is a prominent museum located in the capital city of Uttar Pradesh, India. The museum is in the Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Zoological Gardens, Banarasi Bagh, Lucknow.

gomti nagar.title: Gomti Nagar
gomti nagar.summary: Gomti Nagar is an area in the Indian city of Lucknow consisting of both residential and business settlements. It is one of the largest and fastest-growing areas of Lucknow.

dilkusha kothi.title: Dilkusha Kothi
dilkusha kothi.summary: Dilkusha Kothi is the remains of an eighteenth-century house built in the English baroque style in the quiet Dilkusha area of Lucknow in India. Today there are only a few towers and external walls as a monument, though the extensive gardens remain.

indira gandhi planetarium.title: Indira Gandhi Planetarium
indira gandhi planetarium.summary: The Indira Gandhi Planetarium, also known as the Patna Planetarium, is located in Patna's Indira Gandhi Science Complex. The planetarium was constructed through Bihar Council on Science & Technology at a total cost of about ₹110 million.

qutub minar.title: Qutb Minar
qutub minar.summary: The Qutb Minar, also spelled Qutub Minar and Qutab Minar, is a minaret and victory tower, built during the Delhi sultanate, and comprising the Qutb complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Mehrauli, South Delhi, India. It was mostly built between 1199 and 1220, contains 399 steps, and is one of the most-frequented heritage spots in the city.

india gate.title: India Gate
india gate.summary: India Gate, formerly known as the All India War Memorial, is a prominent war memorial situated on the eastern edge of the ceremonial axis of New Delhi India, officially known as Kartavya Path. It stands as a memorial commemorating 74,187 soldiers of the Indian Army who died between 1914 and 1921 in the First World War, in France, Flanders, Mesopotamia, Persia, East Africa, Gallipoli and the Third Anglo-Afghan War.

chandni chowk.title: Chandni Chowk
chandni chowk.summary: The Chandni Chowk is a street market square it is one of the oldest and busiest markets in Old Delhi, India. Located close to the Old Delhi railway station, the Mughal-era Red Fort is located at the eastern fringes of Chandni Chowk.

red fort.title: Red Fort
red fort.summary: The Red Fort is a historic Mughal fort located in the Old Delhi area of Delhi, India. It served as the main residence of the Mughal emperors.

national museum.title: List of national museums
national museum.summary: A national museum can be a museum maintained and funded by a national government. In many countries it denotes a museum run by the central government, while other museums are run by regional or local governments.

connaught place.title: Connaught Place
connaught place.summary:
Connaught Place is a place name of various places in the world:Connaught Place, New Delhi, officially Rajiv Chowk, an affluent business centre and tourist attraction in New Delhi, Delhi, India
Connaught Place in Central, Hong Kong
Connaught Place, London in London, England
Taman Connaught, Kuala Lumpur in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

lotus temple.title: Lotus Temple
lotus temple.summary: The Lotus Temple is a Baháʼí House of Worship in New Delhi, India. It was completed in December 1986.

akshardham temple.title: Swaminarayan Akshardham (Delhi)
akshardham temple.summary: Swaminarayan Akshardham is a Hindu temple and campus in Delhi, India. The temple is close to the border with Noida.

hauz khas village.title: Hauz Khas
hauz khas village.summary: Hauz Khas is a neighborhood in South Delhi, its heart being the historic Hauz Khas Complex. Well known in medieval times, the Hauz Khas village has buildings built around the reservoir.

humayun's tomb.title: Humayun's tomb
humayun's tomb.summary: Humayun's tomb is the tomb of Mughal Emperor Humayun situated in Delhi, India. The tomb was commissioned by Humayun's first wife and chief consort, Empress Bega Begum under her patronage in 1558, and designed by Mirak Mirza Ghiyas and his son, Sayyid Muhammad, Persian architects chosen by her.

jama masjid.title: Congregational mosque
jama masjid.summary: A congregational mosque or Friday mosque, or sometimes great mosque or grand mosque, is a mosque for hosting the Friday noon prayers known as jumu'ah. It can also host the Eid prayers in situations when there is no musalla or eidgah available nearby to host the prayers.

national gallery of modern art.title: National Gallery of Modern Art
national gallery of modern art.summary: The National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) is the premier art gallery under the Indian Ministry of Culture. The main museum at Jaipur House in New Delhi was established on 29 March 1954 by the Government of India, with subsequent branches at Mumbai and Bangalore.

rashtrapati bhavan.title: Rashtrapati Bhavan
rashtrapati bhavan.summary: The Rashtrapati Bhavan, formerly Viceroy's House (1931–1947) and Government House (1947–1950) is the official residence of the President of India, located at the western end of Rajpath, Raisina Hill in New Delhi..

purana qila.title: Purana Qila
purana qila.summary: Purana Qila is one of the oldest forts in Delhi, India. It was built by the second Mughal Emperor Humayun and Surid Sultan Sher Shah Suri.

national rail museum.title: National Railway Museum (disambiguation)
national rail museum.summary: The British National Railway Museum is in York, England..

dilli haat.title: Dilli Haat
dilli haat.summary: Dilli Haat is a paid-entrance open-air market, food plaza, and craft bazaar located in Delhi. The area is run by Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation (DTTDC), and unlike the traditional weekly market, the village Haat, Dilli Haat is permanent.

paharganj.title: Paharganj
paharganj.summary: Paharganj is a neighbourhood of Central Delhi, located just west of the New Delhi Railway Station. Known as Shahganj or King's ganj or market place during Mughal era, it is one of the three administrative subdivisions, of the Central Delhi district, of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, with the other two being, Darya Ganj and Karol Bagh..

khan market.title: Khan Market
khan market.summary: Khan Market is a shopping district and retail market in New Delhi, India. It was established in 1951 by the newly constituted Republic of India's Rehabilitation Ministry to give economic opportunities to refugees of the Partition of India, especially those from the North West Frontier Province (NWFP), now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, a province in Pakistan.

sadar bazaar.title: Saddar Bazaar
sadar bazaar.summary: Saddar Bazaar is usually the main market or bazaar in most of the cantonments of India and Pakistan..

tughlaqabad fort.title: Tughlaqabad Fort
tughlaqabad fort.summary: Tughluqabad Fort is a ruined fort in Delhi, India. Ghiyasuddin Tughluq, the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty and ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, constructed it in 1321 when he established the third historic city of Delhi.

safdarjung's tomb.title: Tomb of Safdar Jang
safdarjung's tomb.summary: Safdarjung's tomb is a sandstone and marble mausoleum in Delhi, India. It was built in 1754 in the late Mughal Empire style for Nawab Safdarjung.

raj ghat.title: Raj Ghat and associated memorials
raj ghat.summary: Raj Ghat is a memorial complex in New Delhi, India. The first memorial was dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi where a black marble platform was raised to mark the spot of his cremation on 31 January 1948 and consists of an eternal flame at one end.

laxman jhula.title: Lakshman Jhula
laxman jhula.summary: Lakshman Jhula is a suspension bridge across the river Ganges. This is a very famous and older bridge on river ganga and has been closed from 2020.

triveni ghat.title: Triveni Ghat
triveni ghat.summary: The Triveni Ghat is a ghat situated in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. It is the biggest and most famous ghat in Rishikesh, located at the banks of the Ganges..

parmarth niketan ashram.title: Parmarth Niketan
parmarth niketan ashram.summary: Parmarth Niketan is an ashram located in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India..

kashi vishwanath temple.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
kashi vishwanath temple.summary: Kashi Vishwanath Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva. It is located in Vishwanath Gali, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India.

durga temple.title: Durga Mandir
durga temple.summary: Durga Mandir  may refer to the following temples:.

chunar fort.title: Chunar Fort
chunar fort.summary: The Chunar Fort is located in Mirzapur district of Uttar Pradesh, in India. The fort and Chunar town, near Mirzapur city, situated below the fort, are two historic places with common history and legends.

triveni sangam.title: Triveni Sangam
triveni sangam.summary: In Hindu tradition, Triveni Sangam is the confluence of three rivers that is a sacred place, with a bath here said to flush away all of one's sins and free one from the cycle of rebirth..

anand bhawan.title: Anand Bhavan
anand bhawan.summary: The Anand Bhavan is a historic house museum in Prayagraj, India, focusing on the Nehru family. It was bought by Indian political leader Motilal Nehru in the 1930s to serve as the residence of the Nehru family when the original mansion Swaraj Bhavan was transformed into the local headquarters of the Indian National Congress.

banaras hindu university.title: Banaras Hindu University
banaras hindu university.summary: Banaras Hindu University   (BHU), formerly Benares Hindu University, is a collegiate, central, and research university located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, and founded in 1916. It is ranked amongst the most prestigious universities of the country.

ramnagar fort.title: Ramnagar Fort
ramnagar fort.summary: The Ramnagar Fort is a fortification in Ramnagar, Varanasi, India. It is located near the Ganges on its eastern bank, opposite to the Tulsi Ghat.

mangla gauri temple.title: Mangla Gauri Temple
mangla gauri temple.summary: Mangla Gauri Temple is a Hindu temple and Shakta pitha, in Gaya, Bihar, India was mentioned in Padma Purana, Vayu Purana and Agni Purana and Devi Bhagvata Purana and Markandeya Purana in other scriptures and tantric works. This temple is among the eighteen maha Shakta pithas.

bharat mata temple.title: Bharat Mata Mandir
bharat mata temple.summary: Bharat Mata Mandir is located on the Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith campus in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Instead of traditional statues of gods and goddesses, this temple has a huge map of Akhand Bharat carved in marble.

sarnath.title: Sarnath
sarnath.summary: Sarnath is a town northeast of Varanasi, in Uttar Pradesh, India. As the Lalitavistara sutra states, the Gautama Buddha chose "Deer Park by the Hill of the Fallen Sages, outside of Varanasi" for his first teaching after he attained enlightenment in Bodh Gaya.

assi ghat.title: Assi Ghat
assi ghat.summary: Assi Ghat is the southernmost ghat in Varanasi, India. To most visitors to Varanasi, it is known for being a place where long-term foreign students, researchers, and tourists live.

tulsi manas temple.title: Tulsi Manas Mandir
tulsi manas temple.summary: Tulsi Manas Mandir is one of the most famous temples in the holy city of Varanasi. This temple has great historical and cultural importance in Hinduism since the ancient Hindu epic Ramcharitmanas was originally written at this place by Hindu poet-saint, reformer and philosopher Goswami Tulsidas in the 16th century..

dashashwamedh ghat.title: Dashashwamedh Ghat
dashashwamedh ghat.summary: Dashashwamedh Ghat is a main ghat in Varanasi located on the Ganges River in Uttar Pradesh, India. It is located close to Vishwanath Temple.

nizamuddin dargah.title: Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah
nizamuddin dargah.summary: The Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah is the dargah and mosque complex of the Sufi saint Nizamuddin Auliya, located in the Nizamuddin West area of Delhi, India. The dargah, or mausoleum, is a Sufi shrine and is visited by thousands of pilgrims every week.

hongkong.title: Hong Kong
hongkong.summary: Hong Kong is a special administrative region of China. Situated on China's southern coast just south of Shenzhen, it consists of Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the New Territories.

victoria peak.title: Victoria Peak
victoria peak.summary: Victoria Peak is a hill on the western half of Hong Kong Island. It is also known as Mount Austin, and locally as The Peak only generally.

temple street night market.title: Temple Street, Hong Kong
temple street night market.summary: Temple Street is a street located in the areas of Jordan and Yau Ma Tei in Kowloon, Hong Kong. It is known for its night market and is one of the busiest flea markets at night in the territory.

wong tai sin temple.title: Wong Tai Sin Temple
wong tai sin temple.summary:
Wong Tai Sin Temple may refer to:Wong Tai Sin Temple, a shrine and tourist attraction in Hong Kong
Wong Tai Sin Temple (Guangzhou), a temple in Guangzhou, Guangdong province, China
Wong Dai Sin Temple (Markham), a Taoist temple in Ontario, Canada

.

repulse bay.title: Repulse Bay
repulse bay.summary: Repulse Bay or Tsin Shui Wan is a bay in the southern part of Hong Kong Island, located in the Southern District, Hong Kong. It is one of the most expensive residential areas in the world..

ngong ping 360.title: Ngong Ping 360
ngong ping 360.summary: Ngong Ping 360 is a bicable gondola lift on Lantau Island in Hong Kong. Intended to improve tourism to the area, the aerial lift was previously known as Tung Chung Cable Car Project before acquiring the Ngong Ping 360 brand in April 2005.

tung chung bay.title: Tung Chung Bay
tung chung bay.summary: Tung Chung Bay is a bay west of Tung Chung, Lantau Island, Hong Kong, near North Lantau New Town and Hong Kong International Airport. It is also the location of Old Tung Chung Pier..

paris.title: Paris
paris.summary: Paris is the capital and largest city of France, with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km2 (40.7 sq mi), and a metropolitan population of 13.2 million as of January 2026. Located on the river Seine in the centre of the Île-de-France region, it is the largest metropolitan area and fourth-most populous city in the European Union (EU).

eiffel tower.title: Eiffel Tower
eiffel tower.summary: The Eiffel Tower is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889..

mus\u00e9e d'orsay.title: Musée d'Orsay
mus\u00e9e d'orsay.summary: The Musée d'Orsay is a museum in Paris, France, on the Left Bank of the Seine. It is housed in the former Gare d'Orsay, a Beaux-Arts railway station built from 1898 to 1900.

champ de mars.title: Champ de Mars
champ de mars.summary: The Champ de Mars is a large public greenspace in Paris, France, located in the seventh arrondissement, between the Eiffel Tower to the northwest and the École Militaire to the southeast. The park is named after the Campus Martius in Rome, which was dedicated to the god Mars.

louvre museum.title: Louvre
louvre museum.summary: The Louvre, or the Louvre Museum, is a national art museum in Paris, France..

palais-royal.title: Palais-Royal
palais-royal.summary: The Palais-Royal is a former French royal palace located on Rue Saint-Honoré in the 1st arrondissement of Paris. The screened entrance court faces the Place du Palais-Royal, opposite the Louvre.

jardin des tuileries.title: Tuileries Garden
jardin des tuileries.summary: The Tuileries Garden is a public garden between the Louvre and the Place de la Concorde in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, France. Created by Catherine de' Medici as the garden of the Tuileries Palace in 1564, it was opened to the public in 1667 and became a public park after the French Revolution.

notre-dame cathedral.title: Notre-Dame de Paris
notre-dame cathedral.summary: Notre-Dame de Paris, often referred to simply as Notre-Dame, is a medieval Catholic cathedral on the Île de la Cité, in the 4th arrondissement of Paris, France. It is the cathedral church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Paris..

sainte-chapelle.title: Sainte-Chapelle
sainte-chapelle.summary: The Sainte-Chapelle is a royal chapel in the Gothic style, within the medieval Palais de la Cité, the residence of the Kings of France until the 14th century, on the Île de la Cité in the River Seine in Paris, France..

\u00eele de la cit\u00e9.title: Île de la Cité
\u00eele de la cit\u00e9.summary: The Île de la Cité is one of two natural islands on the Seine River in central Paris. It spans 22.5 hectares of land.

arc de triomphe.title: Arc de Triomphe
arc de triomphe.summary: The Arc de Triomphe de l'Étoile, often simply called the Arc de Triomphe, is one of the most famous monuments in Paris, France. It is located at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, at the centre of the Place Charles de Gaulle—formerly known as the Place de l'Étoile—named for the star-shaped configuration formed by the convergence of twelve radiating avenues.

champs-\u00e9lys\u00e9es.title: Champs-Élysées
champs-\u00e9lys\u00e9es.summary: The Avenue des Champs-Élysées, usually shortened to the Champs-Élysées, is an avenue in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, France. The avenue is 1.9 kilometres (1.2 mi) long and 70 metres (230 ft) wide, running between the Place de la Concorde in the east and the Place Charles de Gaulle in the west, where the Arc de Triomphe is located.

place de la concorde.title: Place de la Concorde
place de la concorde.summary: The Place de la Concorde, originally the Place Louis XV, and later the Place Louis XVI, is a public square in Paris. Measuring 7.6 ha in area, it is the largest square in the city.

montmartre.title: Montmartre
montmartre.summary: Montmartre is a large hill in Paris' northern 18th arrondissement. It is 130 m (430 ft) high and gives its name to the surrounding district, part of the Right Bank.

basilique du sacr\u00e9-c\u0153ur.title: Sacré-Cœur, Paris
basilique du sacr\u00e9-c\u0153ur.summary: The Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre, commonly known as Sacré-Cœur Basilica or simply Sacré-Cœur, is a Catholic church and minor basilica in Paris dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus..

place du tertre.title: Place du Tertre
place du tertre.summary: The Place du Tertre is a square in the 18th arrondissement of Paris, France. Only a few streets away from the Basilica of the Sacré Cœur and the Lapin Agile cabaret, it is near the summit of the city's elevated Montmartre quarter..

grand palais.title: Grand Palais
grand palais.summary: The Grand Palais des Champs-Élysées, commonly known as the Grand Palais, is a historic site, exhibition hall and museum complex located in the 8th arrondissement of Paris between the Champs-Élysées and the Seine, France on Avenue Winston-Churchill. Construction of the Grand Palais began in 1897 following the demolition of the Palais de l'Industrie to prepare for the Universal Exposition of 1900.

palais garnier.title: Palais Garnier
palais garnier.summary: The Palais Garnier, also known as Opéra Garnier, is a historic 1,979-seat opera house at the Place de l'Opéra in the 9th arrondissement of Paris, France. It was built for the Paris Opera from 1861 to 1875 at the behest of Emperor Napoleon III.

galerie v\u00e9ro-dodat.title: Galerie Véro-Dodat
galerie v\u00e9ro-dodat.summary: The Galerie Véro-Dodat is one of the covered passages of Paris. It is located in the 1st arrondissement, connecting the Rue de Jean-Jacques Rousseau and the Rue Croix-des-Petits-Champs.

place vend\u00f4me.title: Place Vendôme
place vend\u00f4me.summary: The Place Vendôme, originally the Place Louis-le-Grand, and later the Place Internationale, is a public square in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, located to the north of the Tuileries Gardens and east of the Église de la Madeleine. It is the starting point of the Rue de la Paix.

galeries lafayette.title: Galeries Lafayette
galeries lafayette.summary: Galeries Lafayette is an upmarket French department store chain. The flagship store is located on Boulevard Haussmann in the 9th arrondissement of Paris.

op\u00e9ra bastille.title: Opéra Bastille
op\u00e9ra bastille.summary: The Opéra Bastille is a modern opera house in the 12th arrondissement of Paris, France. Inaugurated in 1989 as part of President François Mitterrand's Grands Travaux, it became the main facility of the Paris National Opera, France's principal opera company, alongside the older Palais Garnier; most opera performances are shown at the Bastille along with some ballet performances and symphony concerts, while Palais Garnier presents a mix of opera and ballet performances..

agar.title: Agar
agar.summary: Agar, or agar-agar, is a jelly-like substance consisting of polysaccharides obtained from the cell walls of some species of red algae, primarily from the Gracilaria genus and the Gelidiaceae family (tengusa). As found in nature, agar is a mixture of two components, the linear polysaccharide agarose and a heterogeneous mixture of smaller molecules called agaropectin.

kalinjar fort.title: Kalinjar Fort
kalinjar fort.summary: Kalinjar is a fortress-city in Banda district of Uttar Pradesh, India. It was ruled by several dynasties, including the Guptas, the Vardhana dynasty, the Chandelas, Solankis of Rewa, Mughals and the Marathas..

agar (india).title: Agar (disambiguation)
agar (india).summary: Agar is a gelatinous substance with culinary and microbiological uses..

husainabad clock tower.title: Husainabad Clock Tower
husainabad clock tower.summary: Husainabad Clock Tower is a clock tower located in the Lucknow city of India. It was built in the late 19th century by Nasir-ud-Din Haidar Shah to mark the arrival of Sir George Couper, the lieutenant governor of North-West Province.

ambedkar memorial park.title: Ambedkar Memorial Park
ambedkar memorial park.summary: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Samajik Parivartan Sthal, is a public memorial in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.
